mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.uid, u.username, u.avatar, c.content, c.create_time FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.uid = u.id WHERE c.text_id = #{textId} AND c.parent_id is null ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{page}, #{pageSize}

SELECT c.id, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.uid, u.username, u.avatar, c.content, c.create_time FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.uid = u.id WHERE c.parent_id is not null AND c.parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
